title: My new shelter Sheltie was thrilled and so was I!
text: My dog, adopted from the shelter last month, was sent home with a Bark Box, donated by the company to our local humane society. It was the box for tough chewers. He's a sheltie, and the toys were bigger than him!  I drove the toys back to the shelter 23 miles away so another dog could benefit, and he ate the treats.  I ordered this Medium Bark Box to get him appropriately sized toys. He was thrilled with this and so was I. Quality treats and toys!!!! US made! EXC. Both dog and owner happy! Well rounded box. We'll be back!!!!! Thank you Bark Box for helping out our local shelter and for a great product!
label: positive
